name: Lynxie · Gremlet #41
description:
A lynx kit with fancy ear tufts and enormous paws it hasn't grown into yet.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Lynxie in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
